title: factdiff review items are judged in batches by a no-tool structured-output call, and only contradicted or undecided facts go to an agent group
goal: A census command (census.py judge LOG or factdiff.py review --judge) sends factdiff review items, each a fact with its old and new passage, in batches to one model call per batch with no tools and a JSON Schema result (supported, contradicted or not enough information per fact, with the sentence that decides it), through claude -p --output-format json --json-schema with --max-budget-usd [DOC S1800, S1824] or the Message Batches API at its 50% discount [DOC S-3pftmimx], the route and model chosen by the research story and stated in the goal before the start; a source whose every fact is supported is recorded confirmed with no agent; the rest go to census.py groups with only their undecided facts; each call's total_cost_usd and tokens are recorded in the census.phase ops row; the suite tests it with a stub in place of the model call, never a paid run; --dry-run prints the batch count and the estimated tokens and USD from the queue block.
notes: Evidence: kb/_self/reports/fact-diff.md's entra dry run gave 43 review items in 24,212 characters (about 6k tokens) against 750,943 characters (about 190k tokens) for the changed pages, and each item is self-contained (fact, old passage, new passage), so it needs no tools and no agent loop. Product facts: claude -p --json-schema with --output-format json validates the result into structured_output, and the JSON names total_cost_usd (public/claude/ci-and-headless.md:34, :72, S1800); --max-budget-usd caps print-mode spend (public/agents/headless-agent-runtimes.md:52, S1824); Message Batches cost 50% of standard pricing, most finish within 1 hour, 24-hour expiry (public/claude/messages-api.md:88, :91, S-3pftmimx), but need an API key the clone may not hold, which the research story settles. Open for the research story (no operator gate, per the session that filed this): the model (Haiku or Sonnet), the batch size, and the agreement bar against a held-out set of review items judged by the current route. A paid run is dry-run first and its cap set from the estimate. Its default model is provisional: ST-jkehwsu4 measures Haiku 5.5 against it on held-out items and switches the default when Haiku holds the bars.
